title: Congruences for Overcubic Partition $k$-Tuples
summary: In the last few years, a number of authors have proved divisibility properties satisfied by various functions which count the number of overcubic partition $k$--tuples of weight $n$ for small values of $k$. In this work, we use generating functions to prove some of their results as well as multiple infinite families of new congruences for overcubic partition $k$-tuples which do not yet appear in the literature.
